slides.title: Title & Vision
slides.headline: Powered AI: Autonomous Operational Intelligence
bullets: Eliminating unexpected industrial downtime with real-time predictive intelligence
Founded by experienced full-stack & AI engineers

slides.headline: Unplanned Downtime Costs Industrial Operators $50B Annually
bullets: Manual scheduled inspections fail to detect sudden mechanical wear
Unexpected catastrophic failures halt operations for days
Legacy enterprise monitoring tools cost $100k+ and take 6 months to install
slides.speakerNotes: Highlight the acute emotional and financial pain felt by plant managers.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.headline: Plug-and-Play Predictive Intelligence in 15 Minutes
bullets: Universal data ingestion from existing sensors and controllers
Pre-trained anomaly detection models pinpoint mechanical failure 14 days early
Automated root-cause diagnostics and work-order generation
slides.speakerNotes: Emphasize how our 15-minute setup destroys legacy competitive friction.

bullets: Sub-second telemetry processing with TimescaleDB & Fastify
Edge-optimized inference with zero raw data leakage
Automated executive ROI calculation engine proving customer dollar savings
slides.speakerNotes: Reassure investors on technical defensibility and low marginal computing cost.

slides.headline: High-Margin B2B SaaS with Value-Based Expansion
bullets: Tiered recurring subscriptions from $199/mo to $1,899/mo
82% gross margins with rapid self-serve customer expansion
Target LTV/CAC ratio of 4.5x with < 8-month payback period
slides.speakerNotes: Demonstrate strong unit economics and rapid path to profitability.

Proprietary operational anomaly graph creating compounding data moats
